Updates while closed or covered are verified without starting hidden sessions
Startup, build and GPU errors preserve reachable capsule/project recovery
Rotation/resize update real capsule geometry and content-local hit coordinates
DPR, accessibility text scaling and long titles remain usable
System back/Escape handles menu, page stack and root exit
Native child preview has actual native chrome and hides below Flutter tools
Safe hot updates preserve page state, timers and host geometry
